One entry of the alert event-type registry (FR-AL-010): enough for a client to render the
rule form without a hard-coded list.

AuthMessage.description: A neutral acknowledgement (used where revealing specifics would enable enumeration).
AuthMessage.title: AuthMessage

BoardFacts.description:
AI-extracted (marked as such in the UI). `independence_ratio` is computed in code from the
two verified counts, as a decimal (0.9167 = 91.67%).
BoardFacts.title: BoardFacts

ComparisonCell.description: One company's value for one metric, with its sector-normalized percentile vs the peer set.
ComparisonCell.title: ComparisonCell

ComparisonCommentaryRequest.description: Request for AI comparison commentary (POST — gated by auth + AI budget, like research).
ComparisonCommentaryRequest.title: ComparisonCommentaryRequest

ComparisonCompany.title: ComparisonCompany

disclaimer.default: Analysis only — not investment advice or a buy/sell/hold recommendation.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

Compensation.description: Tier B: rows that add up to their total; the rest were rejected, never repaired.
Compensation.title: Compensation

Concentration.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of holding weights (sum of squares, decimal). 1 = one holding.
Concentration.title: Concentration

DemoInfo.description: Whether this deployment is the public demo, and how fresh its fixture data is.
DemoInfo.title: DemoInfo

DiffPassage.description: One side of a diff item. `source_ids` are backend-issued and resolve via /sources/{id}.
DiffPassage.title: DiffPassage

DraftResponse.description: Suggestions only: nothing is saved until the user accepts them. No stance is suggested.
DraftResponse.title: DraftResponse

EarningsBrief.description: What was reported and what changed, after a report (FR-EB-006).
EarningsBrief.title: EarningsBrief

EarningsPreview.description: What to watch before a report (FR-EB-004/005). Never what will happen.
EarningsPreview.title: EarningsPreview

Freshness.description: Data-freshness metadata attached to data endpoints (API-008, FR-006).

as_of.title: As Of

source.description: Provider or system that produced the data
source.title: Source

GovernanceField.description: One Tier C field. `value` null = "not stated" (absent, or failed verification).
GovernanceField.title: GovernanceField

GuidanceRow.description: The initial guidance for a period, metric and basis (the headline), with later revisions.
GuidanceRow.title: GuidanceRow

GuidanceValue.description: One guided figure as one release stated it.
GuidanceValue.title: GuidanceValue

HoldingData.description: Per-holding raw inputs so the client can recompute aggregates on a what-if weight change.
HoldingData.title: HoldingData

MetricCoverage.description: Which quarterly / TTM periods of one metric exist, and why the others do not (FR-QT-010).
MetricCoverage.title: MetricCoverage

MetricInput.description: One input to a derived metric, linking to the source it came from (DR-040).
MetricInput.title: MetricInput

MetricResult.description:
Deterministic metric output with lineage (DR-040).

A `None` value means the metric could not be computed; `warnings` carries the reason code
(`NEGATIVE_BASE`, `MISSING_INPUT`, `NOT_APPLICABLE_SECTOR`) per DR-041.
MetricResult.title: MetricResult

MetricRow.description:
One reported figure against the prior quarter and the prior-year quarter. `change_*` is
growth (a ratio) for money and per-share figures, a difference in ratio points for margins.
MetricRow.title: MetricRow

Missing.description: A section left out because an input is missing: shown as "Not available: {reason}".
Missing.title: Missing

NoteBullet.description: One AI bullet. `quote` is verbatim from the paragraph `paragraph_id` (a source ID).
NoteBullet.title: NoteBullet

NoteSummaryView.description: `pending` = not generated yet (summaries are made after parsing, never on page load).
NoteSummaryView.title: NoteSummaryView

OwnBand.description: Today's value within the company's own fiscal-year-end values (and today's).
OwnBand.title: OwnBand

PayVersusPerformance.description: Tier A, from the proxy's Inline XBRL. TSR values are the worth of $100 invested.
PayVersusPerformance.title: PayVersusPerformance

PeerSuggestion.description: A suggested comparable company (§37.1 peer set by SIC/industry + market-cap band).
PeerSuggestion.title: PeerSuggestion

disclaimer.default: Analysis of a hypothetical portfolio for informational purposes only — not investment advice and not a recommendation to buy, sell, hold, or rebalance any security.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

PriceBarSource.description:
End-of-day market data: one trading day (`price:{TICKER}:{date}`) or two
(`price:{TICKER}:{date}:{end_date}`), ADR-0054.
PriceBarSource.title: PriceBarSource

QualityPoint.description: One measure for one period. `value` is None unless `status` is ok (never a zero).
QualityPoint.title: QualityPoint

Reaction.description: The price move around the earnings 8-K, described, never interpreted.
Reaction.title: Reaction

RedFlagItem.description: One reported event. `label` and `snippet` state what was reported, never a judgement.
RedFlagItem.title: RedFlagItem

RedFlagsResponse.description:
Empty `items` with a `last_scanned_at` means "scanned through that date, nothing reported";
`last_scanned_at` is null until the first scan.
RedFlagsResponse.title: RedFlagsResponse

ResearchAccepted.description: 202 response when a research job is queued.
ResearchAccepted.title: ResearchAccepted

RiskStats.description: Deterministic price-based risk, computed from `price_history` daily returns.
RiskStats.title: RiskStats

RiskTheme.description: A risk category shared across holdings; each contribution is cited back to its filing.
RiskTheme.title: RiskTheme

SourceDetail.description: GET /sources/{source_id} payload: the record + marked span + deep link (CIT-006).
SourceDetail.title: SourceDetail

TokenResponse.description: Access token in the body; the refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie (AUTH-002).
TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse

disclaimer.default: Positions within ranges, not judgements of value. Not investment advice.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

VerifiedOutput.description: The full verified + rendered result for a block of generated text.
VerifiedOutput.title: VerifiedOutput

WeightedMetric.description:
A portfolio-weighted metric. `coverage` is the fraction of weight that had a value (weights
are renormalized over covered holdings); value is NULL when coverage is 0 (DR-041 spirit).
WeightedMetric.title: WeightedMetric
